_comment: FFmpeg7 single-lib IJK artifact consumed by this fork. This is NOT reproducible from scripts/build_ijk_native.sh (that script builds the legacy FFmpeg4 3-library variant from ShikinChen). The AAR is consumed verbatim from cat3399/blbl; no local rebuild recipe is claimed.

distribution.verification_method: downloaded raw.githubusercontent.com/cat3399/blbl/main/app/libs/ijkplayer-cmake-release.aar via gh-proxy; byte-for-byte identical (cmp) and SHA-256 match with app/libs/ijkplayer-cmake-release.aar

upstream_project.description: cat3399/blbl credits debugly/ijkplayer (via cat3399/ijkplayer mirror) as the IJK provider; the mirror README states single AAR replaces the three .so, CMake instead of ndk-build, NDK r27c, FFmpeg built as static libs.

ffmpeg.detected_from: strings embedded in jni/arm64-v8a/libijkplayer.so and jni/armeabi-v7a/libijkplayer.so
ffmpeg.notes: FFmpeg configuration line embedded in the .so references ijkplayer/FFToolChain/build/product/android/ijkffmpeg-arm64. The exact source tag, patch set and CMake command are not published in this repo; do not fabricate them.

build_recipe_status.reason: The upstream debugly/ijkplayer CMake build project and its exact revision/patches are not vendored here. This fork consumes the prebuilt AAR from cat3399/blbl verbatim.
build_recipe_status.how_to_refresh: Download the AAR from cat3399/blbl app/libs, verify SHA-256 against aar_sha256 above, replace app/libs/ijkplayer-cmake-release.aar, and re-extract the two ARM .so into app/src/main/jniLibs/.
